context.body: A private dispute becomes public evidence of royal discernment.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Solomon hears two women claim one living child and uses a threatened division to expose protective love.
observations.label: A judgment reveals royal wisdom: action

observations.body: One woman yields her claim to save the child; Israel fears the king’s God-given wisdom.
observations.label: A judgment reveals royal wisdom: response

observations.body: no witnesses · divide the living child · compassion · wisdom of God

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 3:16–28 as wisdom and royal order evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The method depends on reading human response and would be destructive if the threat were carried out.
